purpose: Select and freeze exactly one compression-independent entry hypothesis from surviving T-layer research families before any new outcome execution.

problem_elimination_pass.final_user_goal: Find one causal entry mechanism that can eventually issue a strategy PASS receipt and survive untouched validation, without forcing compression to provide timing.
hard_constraints: Use only D and earlier information in signal construction.
Do not use compression level, percentile, onset, persistence or release as the trigger.
Do not use liquidity as alpha.
Do not import lost V2.7.3 thresholds or recreate historical V2.7.3 events.
Use only already-consumed folds 0-2 for development.
Keep fold3 and fold4 sealed until development PASS and a separate confirmatory contract are frozen.
Freeze one candidate only; no post-result candidate additions or threshold search.
No Setup, First60, Episode or live authorization is created by this gate.

reason: Stage-1 ret_20 and ret_60 were preregistered as positive continuation factors but both produced negative direction-adjusted D+10 Rank-IC and negative direction-adjusted D+10 spreads.
Selecting RS continuation now would require reversing or reinterpreting a previously frozen direction after observing results, which is not an acceptable clean next hypothesis.
Stage-1 ma50_vs_ma150, ma150_vs_ma200 and ma200_slope20 did not produce a consistent promotable positive trend-structure signal.
V2.8.8 C1_DC_TREND also failed cross-fold Setup eligibility; this does not invalidate all trend context, but it weakens the case for making static trend structure itself the next entry trigger.
AC was intentionally exploratory-only in V2.8.1 because its expected shape is nonlinear and interaction/event-like rather than monotonic.
That makes AC structurally suitable for a timing hypothesis after static ranking and compression-timing routes failed.
The selected event uses natural zero boundaries around moving-average distance rather than an outcome-tuned overextension percentage.

Delete: Do not reopen compression-derived entry variants.
Do not run RS continuation with reversed sign as a rescue.
Do not run a static TQ percentile or weighted score.
actions.Avoid: Avoid threshold grids by using only arithmetic identity boundaries where price equals its moving average.
actions.Absorb: Reuse V2.8.0 scale-invariant feature engine, frozen PIT identities, joint calendar and folds0-2 source snapshots.
actions.Substitute: Use a pullback-reclaim event to represent anti-chase timing instead of a static rank or compression transition.
actions.Precompute_Reuse: No new source retrieval for folds0-2 is authorized solely for V2.8.10 development.
actions.Optimize: Forbidden until the single frozen event survives development and untouched validation.

single_hypothesis.name: MA20 Pullback Reclaim With Intact MA50
single_hypothesis.economic_semantic: After a short-term pullback has removed immediate extension, price reclaims the short-term trend reference while the medium-term price structure remains intact.

previous_session_P.definition: immediately preceding joint SSE+SZSE A-share trading session before D

requirements: no same-security active research episode already spans D

single_hypothesis.event_definition: P is at/below MA20 but above MA50; D closes back above MA20 while remaining above MA50.
single_hypothesis.event_timestamp: D close / end-of-session state only; no intraday timing claim
natural_boundary_rationale: No percentage extension, percentile or fitted coefficient is introduced.
material_independence: does not use rv10_over_rv60 or tr10_over_tr60
does not use compression state, onset, persistence or release
does not use ret_20 or ret_60 continuation ranking
does not use ma50_vs_ma150, ma150_vs_ma200 or ma200_slope20 as the trigger
is an event transition rather than a static cross-sectional percentile

fail_closed_event_rules: If P is missing from the joint trading calendar mapping, no event.
If P or D lacks a tradable stock bar, no event.
If required MA-distance features are nonfinite on P or D, no event.
A suspension or missing P bar may not be skipped backward to an older stock bar.
No D+1-or-later persistence or recovery confirmation is permitted.
No future outcome, target bar or future feature may affect event construction.

research_episode_semantics.suppression_rule: After an accepted event starts at D, suppress another event for the same security through the fixed D+10 joint-calendar target date inclusive.

forbidden: No MA10/MA30/MA60 or other moving-average grid.
No +/-1%, +/-2% or other distance buffer around MA20 or MA50.
No requirement that the reclaim persist for 2/3/5 future sessions.
No compression filter or compression interaction in V2.8.10 candidate definition.
No trend-score percentile or Q5/Q1 projection.
No gap, bar-range or distance-from-high condition may be added after seeing outcomes.
No market-state or evidence-freshness filter may be added after seeing outcomes.
No coefficient fit or machine learning.
No fold3/fold4 price or outcome access.
not_yet_frozen: minimum event counts and temporal dispersion

next_phase.purpose: Freeze information sufficiency, comparison baselines, metrics and deterministic development PASS/FAIL logic before reading AC event outcomes.
